description: This file defines a class for a dataset representing a vector function, generating points based on external functions for x and y coordinates over a parameter t. It is part of the Image_Graph package, specifically within the Dataset subpackage.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
classes.description: A dataset class for generating points from parametric vector functions, with methods to calculate maxima and generate points based on external functions.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_VectorFunction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the vector function dataset with parameter range, function names, and number of points.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Method intended to add a point to the dataset (currently empty).

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Private method to compute the X coordinate by applying the external function to a value.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Private method to compute the Y coordinate by applying the external function to a value.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the internal pointer to the start of the parameter range.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Calculates the interval between points based on the parameter range and number of points.

methods.name: _calculateMaxima
methods.description: Calculates the minimum and maximum values of X and Y over the parameter range.
